about: The standing rules a session must meet before it works on the Fold/EO research. Each has a source. Edit here; BRIEF.md is generated from this and from experiments/zero-overlap/LEDGER.md (node gym/session-brief.mjs --write); a test fails when BRIEF.md differs from what this would generate.

rules.rule: Default is Other. Sameness is earned by a test an impostor cannot pass; silence is a hole, never a vote.
No model judges whether two texts say the same. A giver nominates; usage licenses against a seeded null.

Stamp the protocol (sha of the PREREG file) BEFORE scoring. A change after seeing data goes in an erratum. A held-out or fresh set is read ONCE; a second scoring is REUSED. Checked by `node gym/ledger-check.mjs`.

Quote every number with its split label (DEV, FRESH, HELD-OUT, REUSED, EXPLORATORY) and its stamp. A measure that changed is a new ledger row or a recorded pin, never the same number under the same name.

Relations, containers and anchors are about referents, not strings. Relationships must be computable from the reading itself; structured data (Wikidata) may score or ratify, never be required at run time.
rules.source: khora CLAUDE.md (the referent rule); the owner, 2026-11-18/19

rules.rule: Read through ONE door: khora native/reading.js readDocument or native/the-fold/read-process.mjs readToWeft. Both refuse a read with no priors unless allowDegraded or KHORA_ALLOW_DEGRADED=1; native/eval drivers are control arms, not the reader. Priors: KHORA_PRIORS_DIR or ~/Documents/janus/priors. Pharos beside khora, or PHAROS_HOME.
Start from origin/main, not a stale branch: `git fetch`, and say which commit you read. A session that began on the cast-identity branch reported 'no pronoun coref' for a gap main had already closed.
Do not push, merge or change user-level configuration without the owner's yes. Commit only paths you can name. The active gh account cannot open pull requests on the org repos; `git push` works.
rules.source: penelope CLAUDE.md (concurrent writers); the session record

rules.rule: A negative result is a finding: record it, with its falsifier. Do not redo what is listed under TRIED AND REFUSED without a new idea.
